name: Apparatus Abyss Cursor Fall
pitch: Hardware-accelerated Three.js WebGL 3D kinetic image spawner plunging floating cards into an atmospheric void.

lifecycle.idle: Subtle ambient floating 3D particle cloud near viewport center.
lifecycle.discovery: Cursor motion anchors WebGL raycast plane and initializes kinetic 3D node stream.
lifecycle.buildUp: Velocity-driven 3D trail ribbon expands along z-depth plane with spring damping.
lifecycle.peak: High-velocity cursor flick triggers orbital 3D particle burst and glowing geometric decay.
lifecycle.recovery: Trail nodes smoothly collapse back into subtle ambient hover ring.
